quote.text: A man should never be ashamed to own he has been in the wrong, which is but saying, in other words, that he is wiser to-day than he was yesterday.
quote.author: Alexander Pope, Thoughts on Various Subjects, 1727

stories.headline: MB&F brought back the Legacy Machine at 42mm, priced at CHF 82,000
stories.dek: The LM1 EVO, announced 13 October, puts the 2011 watch that made the brand into the sports case. Titanium is regular production; the rose-gold green dial is thirty-three pieces.

stories.headline: A Belgian hen called New Kim sold for €1.6m to a Chinese buyer
stories.dek: Bidding opened at €200 on 15 November 2020. Five years on, Britain’s governing body counts 11,742 members, down 14 per cent in a year, and its trade paper is losing 63 subscribers a month.

stories.headline: Air New Zealand returns to Singapore–Christchurch non-stop on 28 October
stories.dek: Three a week on a 787-9, its first Singapore flight on the route since February 2020. With Singapore Airlines, fifteen weekly non-stops at peak.

stories.headline: Sofia opens a war-crimes case over the Chelsea 3 and names no suspect
stories.dek: Sofia’s military prosecutors moved on 16 October, three days after the Chelsea 3 was hit inside Bulgaria’s own economic zone. Seven ships struck this month; two seafarers dead, twenty-five missing.

stories.headline: NEA names seven Indonesian companies under the Haze Act, a first in twelve years
stories.dek: The notices went out on 16 October, the day the central 24-hour index peaked at 229. They order firefighting and a plan of action — they are not prosecutions, and NEA set no deadline.

stories.headline: Ernest Wright’s Sheffield putters still set shears by hand; Gingher is now Fiskars
stories.dek: Two blades touch at one travelling point, and a screw pivot decides whether a pair can ever be re-trued. Ernest Wright’s quality entry is £99; above about £150 you buy size and scarcity, not cutting.

stories.headline: Shares in TSMC fell 3.4 per cent on a $920m beat
stories.dek: Revenue was US$46.72bn against a guided US$44.6–45.8bn; C.C. Wei lifted 2026 growth to “around 44” per cent. Gross margin slipped 1.3 points, and capex is held, not raised.

stories.headline: Apple priced HomeView at S$399 in Singapore and opened pre-orders on 15 October
stories.dek: It ships here on 13 November, in the launch wave for once. Thread goes unmentioned in the release — and the S$299 Apple TV 4K is the cheaper hub with the radio Apple does name.

stories.headline: Fontaines D.C. released Dopamine Chamber on 16 October to a Metascore of 84
stories.dek: Fourteen of seventeen critics were positive, none negative. Paste dissented at C-plus; NME, which this desk reported reviewing four days early, publishes no star rating at all.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The Karolinska Twins
stories.headline: A Karolinska study of 21,797 twins finds shared family factors explain much
stories.dek: Published in Nature Human Behaviour on 8 October. Comparing identical twins to each other cut the association from 0.30 to 0.24 — smaller, and still there.

stories.headline: The US ten-year fell 15 basis points in the worst PPI week of 2026
stories.dek: US producer prices came in at 1.3 per cent on the month against 0.6 expected, four-fifths of it energy. The long end rallied anyway, and Kevin Warsh named the regime in Bangkok.

stories.headline: The American College of Cardiology puts the useful step count at 5,000 to 7,000
stories.dek: Its scientific statement, published in JACC on 15 October, says meaningful benefit arrives well below ten thousand. The same fortnight, the exercise-snack literature lost its headline result.

stories.headline: Studio Ghibli opens at Gardens by the Bay on 18 December at S$39
stories.dek: Resident pricing, timed entry, online only. The Kyushu sumo is sold out on all fifteen days, and the Australian Open’s early-bird window shuts at 12:59pm on 30 November.

stories.headline: Seoul legalised a 33-square-metre cabin on farmland; Koreans have filed 17,983
stories.dek: Korea’s 강층체류형 숬턴 is not a house, so it needs no farmland-conversion permit. It gets twelve years, three renewals, and then in principle a demolition.
